name: Velvet Worm

sources.supports: Damp shelters, anatomy and paired slime tubes for capturing prey.

beats: Insect scuttles into a damp macro forest set.
Track in as worm leaves cover; cycle lobopods and antennae.
Windup, twin jets, camera kick and wet impact.

en.title: This Velvet Worm Shoots Glue! | BESTIARY EP15
en.caption: A tiny hunter with a sticky trick. What creature should we track next? #Shorts #VelvetWorm #Bestiary16Bit
lines: That bug just walked into a trap.
a hunter hiding in damp leaf litter.
It creeps forward on soft, stubby legs.
Then it fires two jets of sticky slime.
but the strands hold it in place.
What creature should we track next?

id.title: Velvet Worm Menembak Lendir Lengket! | BESTIARY EP15
id.caption: Pemburu mungil ini bisa menjebak serangga dengan lendir. Hewan apa yang harus kita intip berikutnya? #VelvetWorm #FaktaHewan #Bestiary16Bit
lines: Serangga ini baru saja masuk perangkap.
pemburu yang bersembunyi di serasah lembap.
Dia merayap pelan dengan kaki-kaki pendek.
Lalu dia menembakkan dua semburan lendir lengket.
tapi benang lendirnya bikin dia terjebak.
